title: Ввести acquire/heartbeat/CAS API и in-memory adapter в PHP/Dart
summary: Добавить в оба SDK семантически одинаковые lease types, `acquire`/`heartbeat`/`complete(lease)`/`fail(lease)` и testkit in-memory store без PostgreSQL.
why: Current ports finish by request identity; types and local CAS can be proved before durable SQL. `RAG:—`.

include: `IdempotencyLease`, `IdempotencyAcquisition`, capability/error types; new store methods; in-memory adapter with token CAS and completed-only expiry; mapping onto three observer states; PHP/Dart tests driven by the P4.1 manifest (non-PostgreSQL cases).
exclude: PostgreSQL adapter; coordinator/tool wiring; package export removal; changing frozen schemas; JCS oracle ownership; KMS; live DB.

rules: `new` acquisition carries the lease; `duplicate_completed` carries stored result/digest; `concurrent_in_flight` carries the existing in-flight error and no lease. `complete`/`fail`/`heartbeat` require the lease object, not the request alone. In-memory CAS is still required so unit tests fail if they ignore the token. `resolve`/`complete(request)` are absent from the production interface; test helpers may wrap acquire for frozen three-state assertions. Tokens are CSPRNG; `attempt` starts at 1. In-memory is testkit/reference-only and cannot be a production constructor default. Do not log tokens.
guidance: Keep `IdempotencyScope` as tenant+tool+key. Advance injected clock in takeover tests rather than sleeping. Shared error spellings come from P4.1. Prefer ULID/UUID for tokens. Test fakes live only in test files.
